alloy_mechanic_overview.description: Alloys are a crafting currency introduced in Path of Exile 2 patch 0.5. They replace the old Entities and Recombination Tools systems. There are 13 alloy types total.
alloy_mechanic_overview.how_it_works: Applying an Alloy to a Rare (yellow) item will randomly remove one existing property and replace it with a guaranteed mod dictated by the alloy type. The removed mod is chosen at random - you cannot control which existing mod gets removed.
restrictions: Target item must be rare (yellow). Magic and normal items are not eligible.
The removed mod is chosen at random from whatever is currently on the item.
The injected mod is fixed: the alloy type dictates it completely.
Some alloys carry hidden secondary effects not listed in the tooltip.
alloy_mechanic_overview.crafting_interaction: Alloys function similarly to Perfect Essences. They are deterministic crafting that swaps one random mod for a guaranteed one. Best used on near-perfect rares where you want to replace a weak mod. The guaranteed mods cannot be obtained through normal crafting methods.
alloy_mechanic_overview.obtaining_alloys: Unlocked through Remnant encounters after completing Farrow's quest in Act 2. Can also be crafted using rune recipes.

alloys.name: Runic Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed Runic Ward modifier.
alloys.crafting_recipe: Adaptive Rune + Rebirth Rune (x1) OR Vision Rune + Rebirth Rune + Prismatic Rune (x2)

alloys.name: Adaptive Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on Runic Ward-missing synergies and minion command skills.

mod_pool_changes.Staff: Gain (42-52)% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage while you are missing Runic Ward
mod_pool_changes.Wand: Gain (21-26)% of Damage as Extra Fire Damage while you are missing Runic Ward
mod_pool_changes.Sceptre: (30-50)% Surpassing Chance to gain a Puppet Master stack whenever you use a Command Skill
mod_pool_changes.Gloves: (10-15)% increased Attack Speed while missing Runic Ward

alloys.crafting_recipe: Earth Rune + Rebirth Rune + Stone Rune

alloys.name: Protective Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on Runic Ward recovery and defense.

mod_pool_changes.Belt: Recover (32-45) Runic Ward when a Charm is used
mod_pool_changes.Shield: Recover (10-15) Runic Ward when you Block

alloys.crafting_recipe: Sky Rune + Rebirth Rune + Bloodletting Rune

alloys.name: Expansive Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on area of effect, mana efficiency, and minion limits.

mod_pool_changes.Gloves: Remnants can be collected from (35-50)% further away
mod_pool_changes.Boots: Temporary Minion Skills have +(1-2) to Limit of Minions summoned

alloys.crafting_recipe: Volcanic Rune + Rebirth Rune + Tidal Rune OR Adaptive Rune + Rebirth Rune + Soul Rune + Rebirth Rune

alloys.name: Swift Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on speed stats: attack speed, cast speed, flask charges, and totem placement.

alloys.name: Cyclonic Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on debuff reduction, skill/ailment duration, and Archon buffs.

mod_pool_changes.Body Armour: (15-30)% reduced Slowing Potency of Debuffs on You
mod_pool_changes.Gloves: (20-25)% increased Duration of Damaging Ailments on Enemies

alloys.crafting_recipe: Rage Rune + Rebirth Rune + Tidal Rune + Cyclonic Rune

alloys.name: Prismatic Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on elemental penetration, ailment magnitude, and exposure.

mod_pool_changes.Martial Weapon: (20-30)% increased Magnitude of Ailments you inflict
mod_pool_changes.Sceptre: Minions have (40-49)% increased Magnitude of Damaging Ailments

alloys.crafting_recipe: Prismatic Rune + Rebirth Rune + Adaptive Rune + Opulent Rune + Bond Rune

alloys.name: Mystic Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on area of effect, spirit, chain, and elemental infusions.

mod_pool_changes.Helmet: Spell Skills have (10-15)% increased Area of Effect
mod_pool_changes.Gloves: (10-15)% increased Area of Effect for Attacks
mod_pool_changes.Quiver: (25-35)% chance to Chain an additional time
mod_pool_changes.Caster Weapon: +1 to maximum number of Elemental Infusions

alloys.crafting_recipe: Adaptive Rune + Rebirth Rune + Time Rune + Arcane Rune + Electrocuting Rune

alloys.name: Sovereign Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on socketed item effect, Runic Ward, and resistance magnitudes.

mod_pool_changes.Weapons: (20-30)% increased effect of Socketed Augment Items

alloys.crafting_recipe: Adaptive Rune + Rebirth Rune + Moon Rune + Toxic Rune + Power Rune + Oath Rune

alloys.name: Celestial Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on spell skill levels, mana, accuracy, and attack speed.

mod_pool_changes.Staff or Wand: +(142-188) to maximum Mana AND +1 to Level of all Spell Skills
mod_pool_changes.Martial Weapon: +(327-427) to Accuracy Rating AND (5-8)% increased Attack Speed

alloys.crafting_recipe: Earth Rune + Rebirth Rune + Celestial Rune + Adaptive Rune + Power Rune + Soul Rune + Cyclonic Rune

alloys.name: Transcendent Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on cast speed, elemental damage as extra cold, physical damage, and attributes.

mod_pool_changes.Focus, Staff or Wand: (39-47)% increased Cast Speed AND Gain (11-16)% of Elemental Damage as Extra Cold Damage
mod_pool_changes.Martial Weapon: (15-20)% increased Physical Damage AND +(7-10) to all Attributes

alloys.crafting_recipe: Sky Rune + Rebirth Rune + Momentum Rune + Rage Rune + Power Rune + Electrocuting Rune + Death Rune

alloys.name: The Runebinder's Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on skill-specific enhancements for various weapon types.

mod_pool_changes.Staff: (25-50)% chance to gain Nature's Archon when your Plants Overgrow
mod_pool_changes.Crossbow: +2 to maximum number of Summoned Ballista Totems
mod_pool_changes.Bow: (40-50)% increased Effect of your Mark Skills

alloys.crafting_recipe: Ward Rune + Rebirth Rune + Soul Rune + Cyclonic Rune + Power Rune + Lightning Rune + Bloodletting Rune

alloys.name: The Runefather's Alloy
alloys.effect: Removes a random modifier and augments a Rare item with a new guaranteed modifier. Focuses on weapon-specific combat enhancements.

mod_pool_changes.Mace: (60-75)% chance for Skills to retain 40% of Glory on use
mod_pool_changes.Quarterstaff: Tempest Bells are destroyed after an additional (4-5) Hits
mod_pool_changes.Talisman: Lightning Damage from Hits also Contributes to Flammability and Ignite Magnitudes

alloys.crafting_recipe: Ward Rune + Rebirth Rune + Time Rune + Cold Rune + Power Rune + Prismatic Rune + Moon Rune
